text:
A linear equation in the unknowns $x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n$ may be written in the form $$ a_1x_1 + a_2x_2 + \ldots + a_nx_n = b $$ , where $a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n$ are real numbers known as coefficients. We also say that $x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n$ are the variables in the equation.

By a system of linear equations or a linear system, we mean a set of linear equations written in a common set of unknowns.
